\label {ex: every vector space with a compatible preorder is a preordered vector space}Let $V \in \Vect{\R}$ equipped with a preorder $\leq$ satisfying the following conditions:
\begin{enumerate}
    \item $\forall x,y,z \in V: x \leq y \implies x+z \leq y+z$.
    \item $\forall \lambda \in [0,\infty): \forall x,y \in V: x \leq y \implies \lambda x \leq \lambda y$.
\end{enumerate}
We define:
\[V^+ \defeq \{x \in V: 0 \leq x\}.\]
Then, $(V,V^+) \in \PreOrdVect$.
